summary: Micware Co., Ltd., a Japan-based software developer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, announcing its participation in two investor conferences on August 19, 2026: the Emerging Growth Virtual Conference and the Sidoti Micro-Cap Virtual Conference. The filing includes a press release and investor presentation, with CEO Kenji Narushima and Micware North America President Takashi Harishima presenting. This is a routine corporate communication regarding investor relations activities, containing no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic changes. The filing is purely informational and forward-looking in nature, with no deal terms or transactional details.
